lines.en: label beachvacation11:
scene mollymaya1
: Well, well, well! Glad you decided to join us, Sir!
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀哎呀！很高兴你决定加入我们，大人！

lines.en: : Yes. Very glad. Hooray.
lines.zh: : 是啊。非常高兴。万岁。

lines.en: I find Molly and Maya hiding from the sun under a slew of parasols on my way down the beach.
lines.zh: 我沿着海滩往前走，发现茉莉和摩耶躲在一堆遮阳伞下避暑。

lines.en: : When you said you were bringing multiple umbrellas, I didn’t really believe you.
lines.zh: : 你说会带好几把伞的时候，我还真没信。

lines.en: scene mollymaya2
: Well, you should have! Without constant protection from the sun, I’m as good as dead.
lines.zh: : 你本该信的！要是没有持续的防晒保护，我跟死了没两样。

lines.en: : I don’t know how you Japanese people handle these harsh Summers so well. I feel like I’m being tossed into the depths of Orodruin every time I step outside.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道你们日本人是怎么熬过这么残酷的夏天的。每次一出门，我都觉得自己被扔进了 Orodruin 的深渊。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么。

lines.en: : Then you have much to learn! Perhaps the two of us should retreat back to the inn and have ourselves a Lord of the Rings marathon? Aye, Supreme Overlord?
lines.zh: : 那你要学的还多着呢！要不我们俩撤退回旅馆，来一场《指环王》马拉松？怎么样，至高霸主？

lines.en: : You’re just trying to escape from the outdoors again, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你只是又想逃回室内吧？

lines.en: scene mollymaya3
: Guh...I had no idea you could read minds as well...
lines.zh: : 咕……没想到你还会读心……

lines.en: : This is concerning for a number of reasons.
lines.zh: : 这从好几个方面来说都令人担忧。

lines.en: : That aside...how are you, Maya? I didn’t really see you at all yesterday once we got to the beach.
lines.zh: : 先不说这个……摩耶，你还好吗？昨天到了海滩之后我几乎没怎么见到你。

lines.en: : Correct. I was beginning to think my plan of avoiding you was going to keep up for the full 48 hours.
lines.zh: : 没错。我还以为我的「回避你」计划能顺利维持整整四十八小时。

lines.en: : I regret to see that this is very much not the case.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾地发现，事实完全不是这样。

lines.en: : Thanks. I missed you too.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我也想你。

lines.en: : Please go away.
lines.zh: : 请你走开。

lines.en: scene mollymaya4
: Are you two like arch nemeses or something? I haven’t really been around long but every interaction you’ve had together since I joined the class has been pretty toxic.
lines.zh: : 你们两个是死对头之类的吗？我来得不久，不过自我加入这个班以来，你们每次互动都相当有毒。

lines.en: : Even thought about reporting you to the GMs on one or more occasions for gameplay sabotage.
lines.zh: : 我有好几次都想向 GM 举报你们破坏游戏体验。

lines.en: : This isn’t a game. This is real life.
lines.zh: : 这不是游戏。这是现实生活。

lines.en: scene mollymaya5
: What do you know, Maya?!
lines.zh: : 摩耶，你懂什么？！

lines.en: : A little too much, I’m afraid.
lines.zh: : 恐怕懂得有点太多了。

lines.en: : Well, it’s a game to me. And it’s a game to the Supreme Overlord as well.
lines.zh: : 哼，可对我来说这就是游戏。对至高霸主来说也是游戏。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what we’re talking about right now.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道我们现在在聊什么。

lines.en: scene mollymaya6
: Strange. It appears as if we might actually be on the same page for once.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。看来我们这一次说不定真的想到一块儿去了。

lines.en: : Though, I suppose that makes sense given that Molly is perhaps the only person I know who is more delusional than you.
lines.zh: : 不过想想也有道理，毕竟茉莉大概是我认识的人里唯一一个比你更妄想的人。

lines.en: scene mollymaya1
: Did ya hear that, Sir? We’re brothers in arms. Fellow degenerates.
lines.zh: : 听见了吗，大人？我们是战友。同道的堕落者。

lines.en: : Who cares if the world doesn’t understand how you and I look at it? As long as we’re leveling up our stats with everybody, I’m sure we’ll survive.
lines.zh: : 就算世人不理解我和你看待世界的方式又怎样？只要我们的属性还在跟大家一起往上涨，我想我们就能活下去。

lines.en: : Molly, why did you come here again? You’re really not suited for the outdoor world.
lines.zh: : 茉莉，你到底为什么来这儿啊？你真的不适应户外世界。

lines.en: scene mollymaya7
: Well, it was to play D&D. But now that that’s over I’m kinda just floatin’ out in the Twisting Nether until the next time we all meet up.
lines.zh: : 嗯，本来是为了玩龙与地下城。不过既然那结束了，在下一次大家聚齐之前，我基本上就是在扭曲虚空里飘着。

lines.en: : Oh, are you guys not playing again tonight?
lines.zh: : 哦，你们今晚不玩了吗？

lines.en: : We are not.
lines.zh: : 不玩。

lines.en: : Ayane’s character died so she needs time to prepare a new one.
lines.zh: : 绫音的角色死了，所以她需要时间准备新的。

lines.en: : There’s the issue with Futaba as well.
lines.zh: : 还有二叶的问题。

lines.en: : She wasn’t able to play last night and I heard that she went back to the dorm this morning.
lines.zh: : 她昨晚没能上场，而且我听说她今天早上回宿舍了。

lines.en: : Wait, really? How come?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : She said she wasn’t feeling well.
lines.zh: : 她说身体不舒服。

lines.en: : I imagine it’s because of the heat.
lines.zh: : 我想是因为天热。

lines.en: : It won’t be an issue soon, though.
lines.zh: : 不过很快就不是问题了。

lines.en: scene mollymaya8
: That’s right, Sir. Winter is coming.
lines.zh: : 没错，大人。凛冬将至。

lines.en: : Why did you say that so menacingly?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛说得那么阴森？

lines.en: scene mollymaya9
: Oh my God! You really don’t know anything, do you? What do you even do for fun?!
lines.zh: : 我的天哪！你真的是什么都不知道啊？你平时到底靠什么取乐？！

lines.en: : He peeks on [young_girls] while they’re getting changed.
lines.zh: : 他偷看[young_girls]换衣服。

lines.en: : I mean, so do I, but it’s normally in the form of a game. You know there are much easier ways to do that, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我也看，不过我一般是在游戏里看。你知道有更简单的方法吧？

lines.en: : Oh please. As if anyone would be attracted to girls in a video game. That just doesn’t even make sense.
lines.zh: : 拜托。谁会喜欢电子游戏里的女生啊。这根本说不通。

lines.en: scene mollymaya3
: I’m just going to pretend I didn’t hear that...You two carry on with your normie conversation while I lay here and innervate myself.
lines.zh: : 我就当没听见好了……你们两个继续聊你们普通人的话题，我躺在这儿给自己来个激活。

lines.en: : Try to do things like that in private, Molly.
lines.zh: : 这种事你还是私下做吧，茉莉。

lines.en: scene mollymaya10
: It‘s a spell to restore my mana and it’s very wholesome!
lines.zh: : 这是个恢复法力的法术，非常健康向上！

lines.en: : I might be a degenerate but even I wouldn’t stoop to doing that surrounded by a crowd of my friends!
lines.zh: : 我也许是堕落，但就算我也不会在一群朋友中间堕落成那样！

lines.en: : My lust level is nowhere near high enough!
lines.zh: : 我的色欲值还没高到那个份上！

lines.en: scene mollymaya13
: Now if you’ll excuse me-
lines.zh: : 那么失陪了——

lines.en: : Bzzzzzzzzzzz...
lines.zh: : 嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡……

lines.en: : What is she doing?
lines.zh: : 她在干什么？

lines.en: : Innervating.
lines.zh: : 激活。

lines.en: : Does she really need to make those noises, though?
lines.zh: : 可她真有必要发出那种声音吗？

lines.en: : Does she really need to do 90%% of the things that she does?
lines.zh: : 她做的那些事里真有90%%是必要的吗？

lines.en: : Good point.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。

lines.en: I take a few steps toward the towel the two of them are sitting on and begin to crouch down.
lines.zh: 我朝她们俩坐着的那条毛巾走了几步，开始蹲下身。

lines.en: : Can I take a seat? I’m getting a little tired of-
lines.zh: : 我能坐下吗？我有点受够了——

lines.en: scene mollymaya11
: No thank you.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : But there’s plenty of room.
lines.zh: : 可这里地方挺大的啊。

lines.en: : I said no thank you.
lines.zh: : 我说了不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : I’m afraid you might accidentally touch me.
lines.zh: : 我怕你会不小心碰到我。

lines.en: : Would that really be so bad?
lines.zh: : 那真的有那么糟吗？

lines.en: scene mollymaya12
: I fear that my skin would melt off if you even thought about touching me.
lines.zh: : 我怕你光是想着要碰我，我的皮就会融掉。

lines.en: : Your skin would have probably melted off by now because it’s pretty unfeasible to think that I haven’t imagined touching you at some point.
lines.zh: : 按理说你的皮早就该融掉了，因为要说我从没想象过碰你，那根本不现实。

lines.en: scene mollymaya13
: You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : How many times is that now? Four? Five?
lines.zh: : 这第几次了？四次？五次？

lines.en: : Not enough to get the point across, apparently.
lines.zh: : 显然还不足以让你明白我的意思。

lines.en: : Why are you even here?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : And where is Ami?
lines.zh: : 还有亚美去哪儿了？

lines.en: : She seemed to take her time waking you up this morning, so I can only imagine what that must mean.
lines.zh: : 她今早叫你起床似乎花了不少时间，所以我只能想象那意味着什么。

lines.en: if amilust10 == True:
Wait...
lines.zh: 等等……

lines.en: Does Maya know about that?
lines.zh: 摩耶知道那件事？

lines.en: I know her and Ami are best friends, but I didn’t think she’d go as far as telling her friend that she’s engaged in [incest] with her [uncle].
lines.zh: 我知道她和亚美是最好的朋友，可我没想过她会做到这一步——告诉好友自己和她[uncle]搞[incest]。

lines.en: That just seems like a horrible idea in every sense of the word.
lines.zh: 无论从哪个角度看，这都像是个糟透了的想法。

lines.en: But...then again...Maya has been known to understand a little more than she’s supposed to at times.
lines.zh: 不过……话又说回来……摩耶有时候确实懂得比她该懂的多。

lines.en: This is incredibly worrying.
lines.zh: 这实在令人担忧。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Apologies. Of course you don’t.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你当然不知道。

lines.en: else:
: I have no idea what you’re talking about. All she did was wake me up and walk down here with me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。她只是把我叫醒，然后跟我一起走到这儿而已。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: scene mollymaya14
: Oooookay. I’m tired of not being involved anymore. Molly MacCormack has joined the battle.
lines.zh: : 好——吧。我受够了被晾在一边。茉莉·麦科马克加入战斗。

lines.en: : Welcome back Molly. How was your intervention?
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来，茉莉。你的干预怎么样？

lines.en: : Innervation, Sir. You need to memorize your spells or you’ll never make it into the raid group.
lines.zh: : 是激活，大人。你得把法术名记住，不然永远进不了团本队伍。

lines.en: : Is that a thing I even want to be a part of?
lines.zh: : 那是我真的想参加的东西吗？

lines.en: scene mollymaya16
: Of course! It’s only the peak of the endgame experience!
lines.zh: : 当然！那可是终局体验的巅峰！

lines.en: : The only thing better than getting a well-rounded raid group is checking the tags and not seeing anything about vore.
lines.zh: : 除了凑齐一支全面发展的团队，唯一更爽的就是翻标签，看到里面没有 vore 相关的内容。

lines.en: : How do you know all of these strange words?
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么知道这些怪词的？

lines.en: : Am I really getting that old?
lines.zh: : 我真的已经老到这个地步了吗？

lines.en: scene mollymaya17
: Yes. I’ve been telling you that since you first showed up at the shrine.
lines.zh: : 是的。从你第一次出现在神社那天起我就这么跟你说了。

lines.en: : You’re disturbingly old. So much so that I don’t understand how you haven’t been arrested for hanging around us in public yet.
lines.zh: : 你的老态令人不安。老到我都搞不懂你为什么还没因为在公共场合缠着我们而被抓起来。

lines.en: : Wow, you’re really firing on all cylinders today. Aren’t you, Maya?
lines.zh: : 哇，你今天火力全开啊。是不是，摩耶？

lines.en: : You’re ruining my vacation.
lines.zh: : 你在毁掉我的假期。

lines.en: : All you’re doing is sitting on a towel. That’s not really high quality vacation material.
lines.zh: : 你不过是坐在毛巾上而已。这算不上什么高质量的度假内容。

lines.en: : And sleeping until almost noon and having your [niece] come to wake you up is?
lines.zh: : 那睡到快中午，还让你[niece]来叫你起床就算了？

lines.en: scene mollymaya18
: That doesn’t sound all that bad to me. I’m sure I’ve even read through a few pretty...interesting scenes that have started that way.
lines.zh: : 我觉得听着没那么糟啊。我还读过几段……挺有意思的场景就是这么开头的。

lines.en: : Why do girls like you exist?
lines.zh: : 为什么会有你这样的女生存在？

lines.en: scene mollymaya19
: Why do any of us exist, Maya?
lines.zh: : 我们任何人又为什么存在呢，摩耶？

lines.en: : What is life if not an excuse to feel pain? To grow old and die.
lines.zh: : 如果人生不是为了感受痛苦，为了变老然后死去，那它又是什么？

lines.en: : It’s how the universe was designed. We’re all creatures just struggling to find our purpose before our time runs out.
lines.zh: : 宇宙就是这么设计的。我们都只是在时间耗尽前挣扎着寻找自己意义的生物罢了。

lines.en: : Is that supposed to be me?
lines.zh: : 那是在模仿我吗？

lines.en: : It was pretty spot on, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，模仿得相当到位。

lines.en: : It was not. She didn’t even get my face right.
lines.zh: : 才没有。她连我的表情都没学对。

lines.en: scene mollymaya20
: Please leave me alone, Sensei. I can not enjoy my vacation with you standing so close to me.
lines.zh: : 请别烦我，老师。你站得离我这么近，我没法享受假期。

lines.en: : Make yourself useful and fetch me a drink before I fade away into nothingness.
lines.zh: : 有点用吧，去给我拿杯喝的来，不然我就要消散成虚无了。

lines.en: scene mollymaya21
: This isn’t funny.
lines.zh: : 这一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : Like my Maya impression, Sensei? It’s pretty good, right?
lines.zh: : 喜欢我模仿摩耶吗，老师？挺像的吧？

lines.en: : That was my first time tryin’ the whole ‘expressionless’ face thing. Did it look okay?
lines.zh: : 那是我第一次尝试「面无表情」那种脸。看起来还行吗？

lines.en: : It was perfect. I actually thought you were Maya for a second.
lines.zh: : 完美。有一瞬间我真的以为你是摩耶。

lines.en: scene mollymaya22
: You’re not funny either.
lines.zh: : 你也不好笑。

lines.en: : That impression was nothing like me.
lines.zh: : 那模仿跟我一点都不像。

lines.en: : Why don’t you give us your best Molly impression then, Maya?
lines.zh: : 那你倒是给我们来一段你最拿手的茉莉模仿啊，摩耶？

lines.en: : I’d rather die.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿去死。

lines.en: : Urrheak here is just jealous that my personality can’t be so easily mimicked.
lines.zh: : 乌尔瑞克在这儿只是嫉妒罢了，因为我的性格可没法这么轻易被模仿。

lines.en: scene mollymaya23
: Your personality can be mimicked by any prepubescent boy in Japan. You aren’t as unique as you think.
lines.zh: : 你的性格，日本任何一个青春期前的男孩都能模仿。你没自己想的那么独一无二。

lines.en: : Do you hear something, Sir? The wind is certainly loud today.
lines.zh: : 你听到什么了吗，大人？今天风可真大。

lines.en: : It’s not even windy.
lines.zh: : 根本就没风。

lines.en: : I don’t hear anything at all.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没听见。

lines.en: : In fact, have you seen Maya around? I’m starting to worry that she might have gotten lost or something.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你看到摩耶了吗？我开始担心她是不是走丢了什么的。

lines.en: scene mollymaya24
: Maya?
lines.zh: : 摩耶？

lines.en: : I’ve never even heard that name before...
lines.zh: : 我从没听过这个名字……

lines.en: : Wait a minute...neither have I.
lines.zh: : 等等……我也没有。

lines.en: : This isn’t funny.
lines.zh: : 这一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting and immature.
lines.zh: : 你又恶心又幼稚。

lines.en: scene mollymaya25
: In fact, it’s almost unnerving how-
lines.zh: : 事实上，这几乎有点让人不安地——

lines.en: scene mollymaya26
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : What are they doing over there?
lines.zh: : 她们在那边干什么？

lines.en: Something off in the distance catches Maya’s attention.
lines.zh: 远处有什么东西引起了摩耶的注意。

lines.en: Molly and I both follow her gaze to figure out what it might be...
lines.zh: 茉莉和我都顺着她的目光看过去，想弄清楚那是什么……

lines.en: scene mollymaya27
: Hah...
: You can do it, Karin! We believe in you!
lines.zh: : 你可以的，花梨！我们相信你！

lines.en: : Yeah! You show that melon who’s boss!
lines.zh: : 对！让那颗瓜看看谁才是老大！

lines.en: : Okay but...I don’t really know how hard to swing the bat...
lines.zh: : 可是……我真的不知道该用多大力挥棒……

lines.en: : Don’t we have anything a little less...well, hard?
lines.zh: : 我们没有稍微……不那么硬的东西吗？

lines.en: : If it ain’t hard there’s no way you’ll kill the melon!
lines.zh: : 不硬的话，你怎么可能把瓜砸烂！

lines.en: : Just give it a good ole whack and show it that you’re co-captain of the soccer team for a reason!
lines.zh: : 你就给它狠狠来一下，让它知道你能当上足球队副队长是有原因的！

lines.en: : Yeah! Even though you don’t really need a bat for soccer and...being the co-captain isn’t really based on strength!
lines.zh: : 对！虽然踢足球其实用不上球棒，而且……副队长也不是靠力气当上的！

lines.en: : Yeah! What Ami said!
lines.zh: : 对！亚美说得对！

lines.en: : Okay...but I doubt I’ll get it on the first try.
lines.zh: : 好……不过我觉得自己第一下打不中。

lines.en: scene mollymaya28
: Oh no...No...
: This can’t be happening.
lines.zh: : 这不可能发生。

lines.en: : I have to go!
lines.zh: : 我得走了！

lines.en: scene mollymaya29
Maya suddenly takes off toward Karin and Molly is left with an expectedly confused look on her face.
lines.zh: 摩耶突然朝花梨冲了过去，茉莉脸上则露出了意料之中的困惑。

lines.en: : The Hell was that about, Sir?
lines.zh: : 那是怎么回事，大人？

lines.en: : I guess you don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我想你不知道吧。

lines.en: : Know what? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 知道什么？发生什么事了？

lines.en: : Maya has a...unique affinity for watermelons.
lines.zh: : 摩耶对西瓜有一种……独特的执念。

lines.en: : It’s actually kind of strange. It’s not even that good of a fruit.
lines.zh: : 其实挺奇怪的。那水果又没多好吃。

lines.en: : It’s really not. It just tastes like...water. And melon.
lines.zh: : 真的很一般。吃起来就是……水。加瓜味。

lines.en: : I agree. But, well-
lines.zh: : 我同意。不过，那个——

lines.en: : Well I guess you’ll see for yourself.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想你自己马上就会看到了。

lines.en: scene mollymaya30
: Oh, crap! I forgot all about Maya!
lines.zh: : 哦，靠！我把摩耶忘得一干二净！

lines.en: : Karin! Abort mission! Don’t kill the watermelon!
lines.zh: : 花梨！任务中止！别砸那颗西瓜！

lines.en: scene mollymaya31
: Thank you for the concern, Ami. But it’s really okay. I’ll figure out a way to make the bat work.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的关心，亚美。不过真的没关系。我会想办法让这根球棒派上用场的。

lines.en: : Sure, I would have preferred maybe a large stick or something like that but...this will do.
lines.zh: : 当然，我更想要一根大棍子之类的，不过……这个也凑合。

lines.en: : This will do nicely.
lines.zh: : 这个凑合得很好。

lines.en: : This melon will die.
lines.zh: : 这颗瓜死定了。

lines.en: scene mollymaya32
: No, you don’t understand! If you blow up the watermelon, Maya will get really upset!
lines.zh: : 不，你不明白！你要是把西瓜炸开了，摩耶会非常生气！

lines.en: : They need to be cut into perfect wedges or else she gets super cranky.
lines.zh: : 西瓜必须切成完美的月牙块，不然她会闹别扭。

lines.en: : Wow. Maya’s actually kinda fast.
lines.zh: : 哇。摩耶跑得还挺快。

lines.en: : Think she’ll make it in time?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她赶得及吗？

lines.en: scene mollymaya33
: Of course she’ll make it in time! A melon is involved!
lines.zh: : 她当然赶得及！事关西瓜啊！

lines.en: : Okay! Here I go!
lines.zh: : 好！我上了！

lines.en: scene mollymaya34
: AHHHH! I CAN’T WATCH!
lines.zh: : 啊——！我不敢看！

lines.en: scene mollymaya35
: The melon is here. I can sense it.
lines.zh: : 瓜就在这里。我能感觉到。

lines.en: Karin miraculously makes her way over to the watermelon and kneels down in front of it.
lines.zh: 花梨奇迹般地摸到西瓜旁，在它面前蹲下。

lines.en: Maya gets closer with each passing second, but who’s to say if she’ll make it in time?
lines.zh: 摩耶每一秒都在逼近，可谁说得准她赶不赶得及？

lines.en: Karin could strike at any moment.
lines.zh: 花梨随时可能挥棒。

lines.en: And with a figure like that I can imagine it would send the watermelon flying into a million tiny bits.
lines.zh: 而且以她的身板，我能想象那一棒会把西瓜轰成无数碎片。

lines.en: : KARIN! YOU DON’T HAVE TO DO THIS!
lines.zh: : 花梨！你不必这么做！

lines.en: : It’s okay Ami...Everything is going to be okay...
lines.zh: : 没关系的，亚美……一切都会好起来的……

lines.en: : NO, LIKE, YOU LITERALLY DON’T HAVE TO DO THIS. WE CAN JUST EAT IT LIKE NORMAL.
lines.zh: : 不，我是说，你真的没必要这么做。我们可以像正常人一样把它切了吃。

lines.en: : A mission is a mission...
lines.zh: : 任务就是任务……

lines.en: scene mollymaya36
: God...forgive me!
lines.zh: : 神啊……请宽恕我！

lines.en: scene black
In the very last second-
lines.zh: 就在最后一秒——

lines.en: Just before the watermelon’s demise.
lines.zh: 就在西瓜命丧黄泉之前。

lines.en: An angel appears.
lines.zh: 一位天使出现了。

lines.en: And the bat immediately connects with her.
lines.zh: 而球棒立刻与她亲密接触。

lines.en: scene mollymaya37
: Ahhh! Oh my God! I-I’m so sorry! I had no idea you were there!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我的天哪！我……我太抱歉了！我不知道你在那儿！

lines.en: : THAT’S WHAT I WAS TRYING TO TELL YOU!
lines.zh: : 我刚才要说的就是这个啊！

lines.en: : I...regret nothing...
lines.zh: : 我……死而无憾……

lines.en: : Let this...be a lesson...on the...
lines.zh: : 愿这……成为一个教训……关于……

lines.en: : Hah...
: On the what?! Tell me your dying wish and I’ll devote my life to making it come true!
lines.zh: : 关于什么？！说出你的遗愿，我愿用一生来实现它！

lines.en: : Let this be a lesson on the...
lines.zh: : 愿这成为一个教训，关于……

lines.en: scene mollymaya38
: The proper treatment...of watermelons...
lines.zh: : 西瓜的……正确对待方式……

lines.en: scene black
They were strange dying words, but they did their job.
lines.zh: 这是相当古怪的遗言，不过它奏效了。

lines.en: Karin spent the rest of her life wandering the world and educating youths in urban areas about how to properly treat watermelons.
lines.zh: 花梨用余生走遍世界，在城市地区的年轻人中宣讲该如何正确对待西瓜。

lines.en: She continuously had to relocate, though, because local law enforcement kept putting out bulletins about a deranged woman entering[school]s and lecturing students about fruit.
lines.zh: 不过她得不停地搬家，因为当地警方不断发布通缉令，说有个疯女人闯进[school]，给学生们讲水果。

lines.en: Maya died shortly after the incident.
lines.zh: 事发后不久，摩耶就死了。

lines.en: We spread her ashes over her favorite melon farm.
lines.zh: 我们把她的骨灰撒在了她最爱的西瓜田上。

lines.en: scene sky
And me?
lines.zh: 那我呢？

lines.en: I bet you’re wondering what I did.
lines.zh: 我猜你想知道我做了什么。

lines.en: But this isn’t my story.
lines.zh: 但这不是我的故事。

lines.en: It’s yours.
lines.zh: 是你的。

lines.en: So what will you do?
lines.zh: 所以你会怎么做？

lines.en: Will you die for what you believe in?
lines.zh: 你会为你的信念而死吗？

lines.en: Or will you be the one bearing the baseball bat axe?
lines.zh: 还是说，你会成为那个挥棒的人？

lines.zh: 摩耶的好感度提升到了[maya_love]！

lines.zh: 茉莉的好感度提升到了[molly_love]！
